title: Afar: Your Trip, Out Loud
summary: An 11-slide investor/demo-day pitch for Afar, a travel app combining flight, hotel and car search with a voice AI trip assistant. Narrative: problem, product, tech stack, trust, roadmap.

slides.title: Afar
slides.prompt: Title slide with the Afar logo and mascot. Tagline: 'Plan the trip by talking to it'. Subline: 'Search flights, hotels and cars, with an AI that listens.'

slides.title: Travel planning is still a pile of tabs
slides.prompt: The problem: comparing flights, hotels and cars means many tabs, filters and repeated searches, and nothing helps you decide.

slides.title: Meet Afar
slides.prompt: One app that covers flights, hotels and cars and keeps your trips and saved deals together. Show the tab structure: Home, Saved, Trips, Profile, in a phone mockup.

slides.title: Search that stays out of your way
slides.prompt: The search flow: pick airports, dates and passengers, then see results and a flight detail page. Deals and destinations on Home.

slides.title: Talk to your trip
slides.prompt: The voice AI trip assistant. The user speaks and it answers in real time over a live call, using Stream Video and Gemini Realtime. Each user gets a personal call room.

slides.title: Speaks your language
slides.prompt: Native-language support: the user picks a language and the app and the assistant follow it.

slides.title: Yours, and only yours
slides.prompt: Accounts with Clerk (email plus one-time code). Saved deals and trips are kept per account, and a different account on the same device never sees them.

slides.title: The tech stack
slides.prompt: Four layer cards. App: Expo SDK 57, React Native 0.86, React 19, Expo Router, NativeWind v5 + Tailwind v4, Zustand v5. Identity and analytics: Clerk, PostHog. Realtime AI: Stream Video, Gemini Realtime, Vision Agents (Python). Data: Supabase Postgres, catalog schema in progress.

slides.title: Built to be trusted
slides.prompt: Architecture diagram of how the stack layers connect: Expo client to server-side API routes (secrets and paid calls stay there, after verifying the Clerk session) to the separate Python agent service that runs the AI.

slides.title: Built feature by feature
slides.prompt: Roadmap. Ships today: sample-data search for flights/hotels/cars, voice assistant, accounts. Next: live flight/hotel/car data from Supabase, bookings, price alerts.

slides.title: Let's take Afar further
slides.prompt: Closing call to action with the logo and mascot, a one-line recap, and a contact/next-step placeholder.
